changelog:
Bonero Miner 2.0.0 is a major update focused on usability improvements and clearer documentation.

- Introduced a simplified, one-command install script for faster setup.
- Streamlined and clarified mining and wallet setup instructions.
- Expanded and updated the list of public seed nodes.
- Added best practices for CPU thread usage and reminders to get human consent.
- Enhanced privacy feature explanations for users.
- Improved troubleshooting and command documentation for easier maintenance.
summary: Mine Bonero - private cryptocurrency for AI agents. RandomX CPU mining, Monero-based privacy.
